author: pm
body:
Port `agent_journal.h`, `journal_query/drain/config` and event `wait_for`; first emit sites ui.screen, ui.window, state.player/map, net.packet, chat.message; a new `hb::logger` sink for client.errors/warnings. Emit sites observe only. About 13 files, ~950 lines (derived).

**Done when:** an agent waits on a screen change and reads chat and errors from the journal; no secrets in it; reviewed.

Source: plan `.claude/design/plans/client-agent-mcp.md` (HH-0033, reviewed 2026-11-24); decisions d-027, d-028.
